etsy.title: Funny ADHD Sticker, Lost Keys Retro Window Decal, Keys Moved to Another Dimension, Forgetful Friend Gift
etsy.description:
A funny ADHD sticker for anyone whose keys have moved to another dimension, set as a retro computer window with two options: Search or Buy new.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• One physical kiss-cut vinyl sticker, shipped directly to you
• Available in 3×3 in and 4×4 in. That's the full print area: the sticker is cut around the window, so it is wider than it is tall and measures less than the full square
• Glossy finish, with a backing that peels away cleanly

HOW TO USE
Peel and stick on a laptop, notebook, planner, or the inside of a door. Made for indoor use, so keep it dry.

This listing is a physical sticker, not a digital download. Thank you for supporting a small shop!
